name: Yanagita Kiriko
source:
A female student attending Minkei Academy and she is Ryuu's classmate.
She likes when various affairs happen, especially those which involve other people's love life, as she is Gemini.
Despite being a girl, she is one of Chris Kanu's biggest fan. She adores her and secretly calls her "Onee-sama", albeit she doesn't address her like this directly when she's front of her though.
It seems like she may have a strong sixth sense(?) [sic].
Her favorite sukiyaki topping is Konjac noodle (糸こんにゃく).
